event.description: Retry the no-LayerNorm-offset candidate with 45000 steps and a 10%-of-base learning-rate floor after its late 98.6% validation plateau.
event.proposal: Family: normalization. Retained incumbent is 3528 parameters at 99.660000%, a +0.660000 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family history: no accepted result; attempt-0010 was an optimization failure for the no-offset model, reaching 98.6% validation near the end of 30000 steps but never checkpointing; attempt-0009 was its repaired implementation precursor; 2 prior attempts. This is not a silent retry: the training condition changes from a 30000-step cosine that decays to zero to 45000 steps with a 10%-of-base tail, motivated by the candidate's late continuing improvement. The architecture and parameter reduction are unchanged. This remains parameterization-preserving normalization compression, not a representational change. It is more informative than the nearest untested alternative, RMSNorm, because it distinguishes insufficient optimization time from the need for LayerNorm offsets before changing normalization statistics.
